caveats: Modelled faults only: one-cycle bit flips of gate outputs and flop outputs. Not a physical glitch model.
Toy 8-bit designs with a constant attacker input and a known reset state.
A number belongs to one netlist. The reference mappings are written by this tool, they are not Yosys output; re-synthesis can share or merge logic differently and change the number.

"At least G" means: no set of at most G-1 modelled flips works, for every wrong input and every number of clock cycles, on the listed netlists. It is an exhaustive search of the model, not a proof about hardware.

goal.meaning: no attack with 1 or fewer modelled flips

move_text.title: Sparse state word as output
move_text.what: Replace the 2-bit state and the decoded output by an 8-bit state word that is the output (as rtl/v1.v, v2.v do).
move_text.why_sound: Changes the interface meaning of boot_word bits only in the sense that they now come from 8 flops instead of one decoded flag; values are the same 0x96 / 0x69.

move_text.title: Voter placement
move_text.what: Remove the single voter net in front of the state register. Either each state bit gets its own kept voter (per_bit_and) or each bit is driven by one copy and the consumer comparing the whole word is the voter (owner).
move_text.why_sound: A voter in front of the register is one net that decides every bit; behind the register no single net does. Behaviour re-checked for all inputs.

move_text.title: More compare copies
move_text.what: Add compare copies that own state bits. Each copy is one more net the attacker has to flip on the compare path.
move_text.why_sound: Adds logic only; the new copies compute the same comparison. Needs the copies to stay separate through synthesis.

move_text.title: Keep the copies separate through synthesis
move_text.what: Map each compare copy on its own (keep_hierarchy until after abc), mark its cells keep before flatten, and do not run abc on the flattened design.
move_text.why_sound: Does not change the logic function. Needed by every other fix: when identical copies are merged one flip decides all of them.

after.label: MEASURED
after.statement: no attack with <= 1 flips on all 3 unmerged reference mappings, all wrong inputs, any number of cycles

cost.note: gate and flop counts of the select-shared reference mapping (MEASURED here); area unit = gates + 6 x flops (assumed weight); latency = clock cycles from reset to the decision (2 in every variant) and logic depth in gate levels

move_text.title: Check copy with infection / alarm latch

move_text.what: Map each compare copy on its own (keep_hierarchy until after abc), mark its cells keep before flatten, and do not run abc on the flattened design.
